results.parent_text:
[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 6. Fees and charges]
6.1 General. All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally. Fees, once paid, are non-refundable except where this policy states otherwise.
6.2 Processing fee. Processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST.
6.3 Legal and technical charges. A non-refundable charge of ₹6,000 plus GST covers legal verification and technical valuation of the property.
6.4 Penal charges. Overdue amounts attract a penal charge of 2.00% per annum over the contractual interest rate, calculated on the overdue amount only. Penal charges are not compounded.
6.5 Other costs. Stamp duty, registration charges and insurance premiums are payable by the borrower at actuals and are not NexaBank fees.

[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 1. Purpose and scope]
1.1 Purpose. This policy sets out the eligibility, pricing, fees, security and prepayment terms for NexaHome Loan, a loan for the purchase, construction, extension or improvement of a residential property, or the balance transfer of an existing home loan.
1.2 Applicability. The version of this policy in force on the sanction date of a loan governs that loan for its life, except where a later instrument expressly states otherwise. Applications received under an earlier version but sanctioned after the effective date are governed by this version.
